name: Sprint Dashboard
description: Real-time TFS Sprint Team Dashboard for CasepointARA. Track work items, burn data, and team velocity across sprints.

name: Sprint Planner
description: Plan team capacity, assign backlog items to members, review the workload dashboard, and push assignments back to TFS.

name: User Performance Report
description: Per-member sprint scorecard — tasks completed, hours delivered, AI adoption split, and bug resolution rate.

name: PR Review Automater
description: Point it at a GitHub or TFS pull request URL, or paste a raw diff, and get a structured code review report.

name: Punch Time Calculator
description: Paste punch IN/OUT times to compute work hours, break time, and how much is left against your daily or weekly target.

name: Markdown Viewer
description: Paste or upload Markdown files and preview rendered output with live editing, syntax highlighting, and export.
